before.title: Legacy Shore Account
before.content:
# An old account

The party followed the shore to Legacy Old Harbor. The original account remains legible.

The Legacy Archivist asked them to find the lost logbook.

after.title: Legacy Shore Account
after.summary: # An old account The party followed the shore to Legacy Old Harbor. The original account remains legible. The Legacy Archivist asked them to find the lost logbook. The old account was supplemented.
